strongest_objection: The map's own contribution is the fossil/vessel line: the one instrument it offers is 'remove the form and see what comes back', and its two boldest moves (Tin of string as a form with nothing behind it, Timing from the volatile house re-fated from vessel to fossil between breaths) are the items that draw that line. Both draw it by assertion. Tin of string's third case, the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door, fails the item's own test: seat him with his back to the door and dread comes back, so by the map's grammar he is Fear with a ledger in another tissue, exactly the merge the author made for the bullied boy's shoulders. Timing is the same skill-born-in-a-dangerous-house as the ledger, and the author's fossil reading rests on the claim that the reading sleeps when the house is gone, which is the one place in the map with no tell; a child of a volatile house who scans a quiet dinner every half second is the ledger's worker, not a fossil, and nothing in the item lets a reader decide. Neither item fails as a mechanism, so this is repair and not rejection: give Tin of string a case that passes and let the demobbed man demonstrate the sorting, and give Timing the quiet-room tell. Second-order: two illustrative cases misfit their mechanisms (the potlatch host is not having anything taken, and the writer who sets a deadline and misses it is a case of manufacture failing, listed as if it succeeded), Bill on release states a purposive cause where the register promises a calendar, and the of-sentence never states the criterion the items actually honor, that a form which returns the load unchanged on removal is parking rather than transmutation. The walk, the hinge, and all seven edges survived my attempts to break them.

items.item: Tin of string: a rule made under a load is kept when the load is gone, as the grandmother who lived through the hunger years keeps a tin of string too short to use, the newly rich founder who still cannot leave food on a plate, the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door; carried by the rule's having been learned as a rule rather than as a response, and the form is a habit with nothing behind it; it outlives the load, so removing the form returns nothing, which is the one test this map has for telling a fossil from a vessel: throw the tin out, and if nothing comes back it was a tin; not fear with a ledger, where the fear is still working.
items.why: The map's only instrument is demonstrated by an item whose third case fails it: the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door is fear still working (sit him there and dread returns), which the map's own test sorts to Fear with a ledger. Also the grandmother's tin is ghost-leverages' famine reflex at the case level, and the item does not say what it adds. Repair swaps the case, uses the demobbed man as the item's own negative demonstration, and states the adjacency by what removal returns.
items.repair: Tin of string: a rule made under a load is kept when the load is gone, as the grandmother who lived through the hunger years keeps a tin of string too short to use, the newly rich founder who still cannot leave food on a plate, the professor who still rinses and dries the plastic bags of a stipend spent thirty years ago; carried by the rule's having been learned as a rule rather than as a response, and the form is a habit with nothing behind it; it outlives the load, so removing the form returns nothing, which is the one test this map has for telling a fossil from a vessel: throw the tin out, and if nothing comes back it was a tin, and if dread comes back it never was, which is where the demobbed man who cannot sit with his back to a door belongs, since the door is still doing the fear's work; not fear with a ledger, where the fear is still working, and not an obsolete power still obeyed, which is the same habit seen from the rule's side, where this sees it from the load's, by what removal returns.

items.item: Timing from the volatile house: a child of a dangerous parent learns to read a room's temperature in half a second and to land the line that breaks the tension before the tension breaks something, and the skill outlives the house as comic timing, as the comedian who can feel a room turn and knows to the syllable when the joke must arrive; carried by the anticipatory reading, and the form is a skill strangers pay for without knowing what it was for; it neither spends nor holds the load, since the house is gone, and is a fossil in the kitchen until a room supplies danger again, as the hostile club does, where it becomes a form that hunts its fuel; not the gallows round, which is a crew's shared container.
items.why: Tested as the closest neighbour of Fear with a ledger (my pair). Both are a skill grown in a dangerous house that strangers pay for; the map separates them only by fate (fossil vs working fear), and Timing is the one item on the walk with no tell for its fate. The ledger absorbed the bullied boy's shoulders as 'the same worker in a different tissue'; the comedian's half-second reading of a room is vigilance, and vigilance is the ledger's worker unless something shows it sleeping. Repair keeps the fossil reading and its edge to Hunting the fuel, and adds the quiet-room tell that decides between them.
items.repair: Timing from the volatile house: a child of a dangerous parent learns to read a room's temperature in half a second and to land the line that breaks the tension before the tension breaks something, and the skill outlives the house as comic timing, as the comedian who can feel a room turn and knows to the syllable when the joke must arrive; carried by the anticipatory reading, and the form is a skill strangers pay for without knowing what it was for; it neither spends nor holds the load, since the house is gone, and is a fossil in the kitchen until a room supplies danger again, as the hostile club does, where it becomes a form that hunts its fuel; the tell that it is a fossil and not the ledger's worker in another tissue is the quiet room: if the reading runs where nothing is at stake, a dinner among friends scanned every half second, the fear is still the worker and this is a ledger, and only where the reading sleeps until a room turns is the skill a fossil; not the gallows round, which is a crew's shared container.

items.item: Fear with a ledger: a fear that would otherwise wander is given a place where it can be satisfied, and there it does the work, checking every column twice, as an accountant raised in a house where mistakes were dangerous is the most exact in the firm and could not tell you why; carried by the fear itself, which is the worker, and the form is a competence others pay for; it holds the load and keeps it working, so the retired accountant counts the change twice at the grocer's, since the fear is in the person and the ledger was only where it was put, and the bullied boy's shoulders are the same worker in a different tissue; not an amulet, where the load rides in an object and comes back whole when the object is lost.
items.why: Left side of my neighbour test against Timing from the volatile house. Survives: its tell (the retired accountant at the grocer's) is the same quiet-room test I asked Timing to carry, so once Timing has it the two separate cleanly. Its amulet discriminator is also the map's unstated boundary criterion, see boundary_case.

items.item: Bill on release: the body keeps the account while the load is on, because settling it would cost the person the hours they need, and presents it the day the load lifts, as the migraine that arrives the morning after the deadline, the fever on the first day of the holiday, the shaking that begins only once the car has stopped; carried by deferral, and the form is an illness with a calendar; it spends the load in one payment, so what it shows is the cost of the vessel that was holding it, which is why the bill is largest after the longest hold; not the body's no, which comes during the load and lifts with it.
items.why: The register promises 'a calendar and a shape, not an etiology', and the boundary claim says the two illness items make no claim about cause; this item then asserts a purposive cause ('because settling it would cost the person the hours they need') and a regularity ('the bill is largest after the longest hold') as fact. The hinge to Second self needs neither stated as fact. Repair makes the cause a figure and the regularity an authored reading; mechanism and fate unchanged.
items.repair: Bill on release: the body keeps the account while the load is on, as if settling it would cost the person the hours they need, and presents it the day the load lifts, as the migraine that arrives the morning after the deadline, the fever on the first day of the holiday, the shaking that begins only once the car has stopped; carried by deferral, and the form is an illness with a calendar; it spends the load in one payment, so what it shows is the cost of the vessel that was holding it, and the map's reading, not a measurement, is that the bill is largest after the longest hold; not the body's no, which comes during the load and lifts with it.

items.item: Cornered generosity: what is about to be taken is given away first, so that a loss becomes a gift, as the bankrupt buys the whole bar a round, the dying give away the furniture, the potlatch host burns what a rival would otherwise outbid; carried by authorship, since a thing given is a thing one had the say over, and the form is a largesse strangers admire; it moves the load into obligation, since a gift makes a debtor where a seizure would have made only a loss, so the cornered giver ends the night poorer and owed; not a spender in this map's sense, though it spends money, since the load is now held by the people it was given to.
items.why: The mechanism is 'what is about to be taken is given away first', and the potlatch case does not fit it: potlatch destruction was a bid in a rivalrous display, and nothing was about to be taken from the host. The other two cases fit. Repair replaces the misfit with a case where the seizure is real and imminent; carrier, form, and fate unchanged.
items.repair: Cornered generosity: what is about to be taken is given away first, so that a loss becomes a gift, as the bankrupt buys the whole bar a round, the dying give away the furniture, the tenant gives the neighbours the good chairs the week before the bailiff's van; carried by authorship, since a thing given is a thing one had the say over, and the form is a largesse strangers admire; it moves the load into obligation, since a gift makes a debtor where a seizure would have made only a loss, so the cornered giver ends the night poorer and owed; not a spender in this map's sense, though it spends money, since the load is now held by the people it was given to.

items.item: Hunting the fuel: a form built under load runs only under load, so when the load lifts the person goes and finds some, as the writer who cannot write without a deadline makes one and then misses it, the discharged soldier who takes the night shift on the locked ward, the retired negotiator who picks fights with the parish council; carried by the form's operating condition rather than by any craving for the pressure, and the form is a life arranged around resupply; it grows the load by recruiting it, and the tell is that the form runs at full quality under a manufactured pressure, which is how it is told from a broken form.
items.why: The first case contradicts the item's tell. 'The writer who cannot write without a deadline makes one and then misses it' is manufactured pressure failing to run the form, listed as if it were the form running; the tell says the form runs at full quality under a manufactured pressure. The priorities entry already knows the fix ('a date with a real cost'). Repair makes the writer's case a successful resupply and puts the cost condition into the tell.
items.repair: Hunting the fuel: a form built under load runs only under load, so when the load lifts the person goes and finds some, as the writer who cannot write without a deadline, for whom a self-set date does not count, takes a commission he does not want for the date that comes with it, the discharged soldier who takes the night shift on the locked ward, the retired negotiator who picks fights with the parish council; carried by the form's operating condition rather than by any craving for the pressure, and the form is a life arranged around resupply; it grows the load by recruiting it, and the tell is that the form runs at full quality under a manufactured pressure, provided the manufacture carries a cost the person cannot waive, which is how it is told from a broken form.

items.item: Lightning rod: a group's load lands on one member without anyone delivering it, because the structure routes it there, as a marriage's strain appears in one child's body and not the other's, a platoon's fear settles on the one everyone rides, the department's dread collects on the new hire; carried by the structure, the least-defended place, and the form is a role, the sick one, the clown, the problem; it moves the load and keeps it moved, so that a rod removed is replaced within the season, and the household that loses its sick child finds another; not downhill delivery, which is an act with an author.
items.why: 'A rod removed is replaced within the season, and the household that loses its sick child finds another' is a family-systems reading stated as a regularity. I leave it, because the boundary claim explicitly confines Lightning rod to 'what an observer of that group sees', and softening the replacement claim would trade the map's strange mechanism for a respectable one; recorded under modality_problems rather than repaired.

neighbor_test.left: Fear with a ledger: a fear that would otherwise wander is given a place where it can be satisfied, and there it does the work, checking every column twice, as an accountant raised in a house where mistakes were dangerous is the most exact in the firm and could not tell you why; carried by the fear itself, which is the worker, and the form is a competence others pay for; it holds the load and keeps it working, so the retired accountant counts the change twice at the grocer's, since the fear is in the person and the ledger was only where it was put, and the bullied boy's shoulders are the same worker in a different tissue; not an amulet, where the load rides in an object and comes back whole when the object is lost.
neighbor_test.right: Timing from the volatile house: a child of a dangerous parent learns to read a room's temperature in half a second and to land the line that breaks the tension before the tension breaks something, and the skill outlives the house as comic timing, as the comedian who can feel a room turn and knows to the syllable when the joke must arrive; carried by the anticipatory reading, and the form is a skill strangers pay for without knowing what it was for; it neither spends nor holds the load, since the house is gone, and is a fossil in the kitchen until a room supplies danger again, as the hostile club does, where it becomes a form that hunts its fuel; not the gallows round, which is a crew's shared container.
neighbor_test.separating_case: The quiet room. Take the accountant and the comedian, both raised in a house where a mistake or a mood was dangerous, to a dinner among friends where nothing is at stake. The accountant counts the change twice at the grocer's on the way; the fear is the worker and it works in every tissue, so this is the ledger. The comedian either scans the table every half second waiting for a turn that never comes, in which case the reading is the same worker and the item collapses into the ledger, or sits at rest and the timing does not exist until a room turns, in which case it is a fossil and the item stands. As written, Timing asserts the second and gives the reader no way to see it; the repair puts the quiet-room tell into the item, after which the two separate by what runs when nothing is at stake.

boundary_case: The widower's overtime: a load appears as eighty-hour weeks, a form strangers admire, and the hours hold it, since the grief returns the first idle Sunday. It tempts because it names a carrier (the occupation of attention) and a fate (hold). Ruling: out. When the hours are removed the load comes back unchanged, which is the amulet pattern the author put into Fear with a ledger's discriminator ('the load rides in an object and comes back whole'); the map's members either change the load (an order out of proportion, a topic with edges, a competence), move it, or outlive it. So the type's real criterion is that removal must not return the load whole and unchanged, parking is not transmutation, and the of-sentence never says so; the items honour it, and the record should state it in of or boundary_claim. The overtime is then the pre-form state from which Shop that dreads (the hours acquire dependents) and Hunting the fuel (the person cannot stop) grow, which is the seed below.

seriation.note: An honest itinerary: the endpoints are real (Beat leaves only the song; Tin of string leaves only the tin) and the hinge Bill on release → Second self teaches something a scalar could not, that a spender is what makes a vessel permanent. The order of the middle three fates (hold, grow, move) is undefended and could be permuted without loss; the author claims no adjacency there, so it is unclaimed rather than arbitrary. Timing's placement beside Tin of string depends on the fossil reading, which the repair makes checkable rather than assumed.

edges.why: I tried to break the antecedent: a family silence breaks toward a household, which has no round built for the brother who is not named, and the item's own discriminator names Anecdote as its counterpart. But the label already carries that fork (crew with a round vs household with nothing built gets the funeral laugh), and the dependency it states, that breaking a silence safely needs a container on the far side, is a real claim whose antecedent fails in exactly the household case. Keep.

The reversal of the removal test is the map's most surprising edge and the reason Timing is on the walk at all; it rests on the fossil reading, which the item repair makes decidable by the quiet-room tell. With that tell present the antecedent ('the house is gone and no room supplies danger') is a checkable state and the edge holds.

I tried the devout demoted surgeon who also hates the licensing board. The label's answer, that such a person carries two loads and the tell is a vow kept with fury, survives the case; the incompatibility is about one load, not one person.

modality_problems: Bill on release asserts a purposive cause ('because settling it would cost the person the hours they need') and a regularity ('largest after the longest hold') as fact, against the record's own boundary claim that the illness items describe a calendar and not an etiology; repaired.

Lightning rod states 'a rod removed is replaced within the season, and the household that loses its sick child finds another' as an observed regularity; it is a family-systems reading, covered by the boundary claim's 'what an observer of that group sees', and left in place to preserve the mechanism.
Grudge battery's 'commonly collapses' after revenge is folk observation presented as typical; the mode's 'authored reading of the typical case' covers it, noted only.
Cornered generosity presented the potlatch as a case of pre-emptive giving; potlatch destruction was rivalrous display, not a response to imminent seizure; repaired by replacing the case.
Tin of string's demobbed man is presented as a habit with nothing behind it; by the item's own test dread returns, so the case was an illustrative instance asserted against the mechanism; repaired.
duplication: Partial at one case: Tin of string's grandmother is ghost-leverages' 'famine reflex in a family three generations rich'. The mechanisms differ (an obsolete power still obeyed, versus what removal of a load-born rule returns), and the repair states what the item adds. No overlap with the sibling fleet maps: status-conversions' Gift that keeps no hand is money converting to respect, not a loss pre-empted; self-trust-repairs' Verdict refiled as move reclassifies a judgment, not a loss. The whole map duplicates nothing in grown.jsonl.
best_unresolved_seed: The parked load. The boundary case (the widower's overtime) is a load held in hours and returned unchanged, which the map excludes as parking rather than transmutation; but parking is the state from which two of the map's growers begin, since the hours acquire dependents (Shop that dreads) or the person cannot stop when the hours end (Hunting the fuel). The map has no item for the pre-form and no edge from it, and the question it points at is which carriers turn a parked load into a form with a shape of its own, and at what point the removal test flips from returning the load whole to returning it changed. The author's held candidate, Deposit with an addressee, is the same question from the other side: a vessel whose capacity is stipulated is parking that never becomes a form.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing five items (the removal test's own demonstrator carried a case that fails it, the fossil skill lacked the tell separating it from the ledger's worker, two illustrative cases misfit their mechanisms, one purposive cause was made modal) and keeping all seven edges and the itinerary.
